thread:
jess: FYI we started a canary for pelion13b-int4 last night with the new quantization table. Seeing intermittent OOMs on long-context sampling (seq ~1500). Low overall traffic but OOMs are noisy.

omar: Any kernel changes recently?

jess: Only the quant table and a patch to the allocator alignment (align to 256 instead of 512). Logs: 

```
# /var/log/inference/pelion-canary.log
[2025-09-01T02:10:33Z] ERROR oom: alloc failed for 73400320 bytes at gpu_alloc.cc:210
[2025-09-01T02:10:33Z] INFO seq_len=1520 prefetch_slots=34 kv_cache=1.2GB post_frag=0.68
[2025-09-01T02:10:33Z] INFO serving-config: max_new_tokens=320 batch_size=6 prefetch=aggressive quant_table=v2
```

noah: Ran a quick A/B locally:
- baseline: OOM_rate 7% for long sessions, p95 430ms
- tweak: max_new_tokens=160, batch_size=4, prefetch=moderate => OOM_rate 0.8%, p95 470ms
- tweak+compactor: add compactor.interval=120s and kv_trim_threshold=0.58 => OOM_rate 0.2%, p95 490ms

omar: Recommendation: create a pelion model profile with conservative defaults and a fallback to pelion13b-int8 for sessions >900. Also add a per-pod kernel-fallback to older allocator alignment if alloc failures spike.

jess: I'll draft the profile:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = "160"
- model.profile.max_batch_size = "4"
- model.profile.prefetch = "moderate"
- runtime.kv_trim_threshold = "0.58"
- compactor.interval = "120s"
- fallback.variant = "pelion13b-int8" when session_len > 900 or oom_rate > 2%
- pod.kernel_fallback = "allocator-align-512" if alloc_failures > 5% in 10m

ops-bot: @jess canary-config "pelion13b: conserv-v1" applied to canary (5% traffic) by ops-bot at 1865432178 :gear:

eval-bot: Eval queued: convos-bench (50/50 short/long), compare int4 conserv-v1 vs int8 & fp16, deterministic seeds. Estimated 2h.

noah: I'll add perf dashboard panels for memfrag and per-kernel alloc failures. Also instrument Optimize to flag quality drift >1% BLEU during canary.

jess: (later) Eval results: int4 conserv-v1: OOM_rate 0.6%, BLEU delta vs fp16 = -0.05%, avg latency +7%. int8 fallback 0 OOMs but BLEU delta -1.3%. Suggest we keep int4 with conserv-v1 and auto-fallback to int8 when session_len>900.

omar: LGTM. Add to the onboarding doc and include a snippet in the runbook for emergency revert to int8.

jess: PR created: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/2789 - includes profile, pod kernel-fallback, dashboard panels, and runbook. Merging after 1h if green.

ops-bot: PR 2789 CI: green.

noah: Promotion plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 3h windows if OOM_rate < 1% and quality drift < 0.7% BLEU. Auto-rollback if OOM_rate > 2% or memfrag > 0.66 for 5m.

jess: Thanks team. Will follow up with patch release notes and docs. :rocket:
